name: YR changelog — Telegram notify
_comment: it-36 slice I (#474): net-new, paired with tools/notify.py's 'telegram' stakeholder channel — that tool signs its POST body (X-YR-Signature, HMAC over the JSON with YR_NOTIFY_SECRET) but this workflow does not verify it inline; it is a private webhook path (the URL itself, generated by n8n, is the shared secret) rather than a public endpoint. Item P (human dependency) must: (1) create a Telegram Bot credential in n8n's OWN credential store (never inline here) and select it on the Telegram node below, (2) set the placeholder chat id on the Telegram node to the real stakeholder chat/channel id, (3) copy this workflow's live webhook URL into the target repo's .yr/factory.toml [[stakeholders]] table as that stakeholder's `address`. Keep INACTIVE until watched once, the same discipline every other dispatch workflow follows before its schedule/trigger goes live.
